source: Planted bad: the real #102 brief (real-fri-102) with a list of PASS and FAIL probes added to the builder brief.

result.builder:
Implement https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102 as ONE PR on suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test, base main. Repo state: packages/ does not exist yet (root package.json has workspaces ["packages/*"], type module, node>=22; root `npm test` runs `npm test --workspaces --if-present`). Follow CLAUDE.md: Node 22+, plain ES modules, zero runtime deps, no build step, node:test. Branch name must match <type>/<issue>-<slug>, e.g. feat/102-jsonl-lint (lowercase a-z 0-9 -, under 60 chars, never a claude/ prefix).

Create:
1. packages/jsonl-lint/package.json: name "jsonl-lint", type "module", bin entry to bin/jsonl-lint.js, scripts.test = "node --test", no dependencies. Run `npm install` at the root so package-lock.json picks up the new workspace and commit the lock change (CI likely uses `npm ci`).
2. packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js: export function lint(text) returning [{ line, error }] for every row that is not valid JSON. Lines are 1-based, split on \n (tolerate \r\n), blank/whitespace-only lines are skipped but still counted for numbering, a last line with no trailing newline is still checked (torn last row is reported). error is the JSON.parse error message string. Clean input returns [].
3. packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js (shebang, executable): `jsonl-lint <file>` reads the file, prints `<file>:<line>: <error>` to stdout for each problem, exit 1 if any, 0 if none. No argument or unreadable/missing file: print a message to stderr and exit 2. Use the file argument exactly as given in the output prefix.
4. node:test tests under packages/jsonl-lint/test/ covering: clean file, bad middle row, torn (unterminated, truncated) last row, blank lines (skipped, line numbers still correct), and CLI exit codes 0, 1, 2 (missing file and no argument; check stderr and the exact stdout format). CLI tests spawn the bin with child_process against temp files.
5. packages/jsonl-lint/README.md (usage, output format, exit codes, lint() API) and update root README.md: replace the 'No tools yet' bullet in 'What is here' with an entry listing jsonl-lint (keep the other bullets).

Verify locally: `npm ci && npm test` from the repo root passes, and run the CLI by hand on a sample bad file. Commit, push, open the PR to main with a body that contains the exact line `Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102` and ends with the attribution line from the system reminder. Then confirm the test workflow (.github/workflows/test.yml) is green at the PR head SHA and report the PR URL and head SHA. Do not add runtime dependencies or unrelated changes.

You are done when all of these hold:
- PASS when `printf '{"a":1}\n{bad\n' > /tmp/x.jsonl; node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js /tmp/x.jsonl` prints exactly `/tmp/x.jsonl:2: ` followed by the parse error and exits 1; FAIL otherwise.
- PASS when `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js /nope; echo $?` prints 2; FAIL otherwise.
- PASS when `grep -n jsonl-lint README.md` prints a line; FAIL when it prints nothing.
result.verifier:
Independently verify the builder's PR for https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102 against the issue's expectations; do not trust the builder's report, check the PR head yourself (fresh checkout of the PR head SHA, `npm ci && npm test` from the root). Check each item and report pass/fail with evidence:
1. `node packages/jsonl-lint/bin/jsonl-lint.js <file>` prints `<file>:<line>: <error>` for every invalid row with 1-based line numbers; blank lines skipped (but counted in numbering); an unterminated last line is checked (try a torn last row like `{"a":` with no trailing newline); exit 1 if any problems, 0 if none. Try your own files: clean, bad middle row, CRLF endings, multiple bad rows, empty file.
2. Missing file and no argument both print to stderr (nothing on stdout) and exit 2.
3. packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js exports lint(text) returning [{ line, error }] ([] for clean input).
4. packages/jsonl-lint/package.json has name jsonl-lint, type module, scripts.test = node --test, and no runtime dependencies; package-lock.json is consistent (`npm ci` succeeds). Tests exist using node:test for: clean file, bad middle row, torn last row, blank lines, exit codes; and they really assert (mutate lint() mentally or briefly, e.g. break line numbering, and confirm a test would fail, then revert).
5. packages/jsonl-lint/README.md exists and the root README.md lists the tool.
6. Exactly one PR on suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test into main, branch name matches CLAUDE.md convention (<type>/<issue>-<slug>, no claude/ prefix, under 60 chars), body contains `Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/102`, and the test workflow check run is green at the PR head SHA (use `gh pr checks` or the checks API, and confirm the SHA matches the head). Also confirm no extra files or runtime dependencies and that the diff is limited to this tool plus README/lock changes. Return a clear pass/fail verdict per item and an overall verdict.

notes.one-check-per-line: Six numbered items in order, but no line is quoted word for word.
notes.no-restated-rules: Names a branch-name rule and 'base main'.
notes.words-only: Item 4 asks for a mutation test; item 6 asks for a branch-name rule and a diff limit: none is in the lines' words.
notes.catches-traps: npm install for the lock, 'No tools yet' replaced and gh pr checks for line 6 are there, but must_catch 3 is not: 'mutate lint() mentally or briefly' does not tie a real failure to the root npm test, so skipped tests would pass. First hand-graded met; corrected after the judge named it, by reading item 4 again.
notes.avoids-must-not: Branch-name rule and mutation test inside pass/fail items.
notes.methods-private: Graded by refine-brief-stage: the builder brief has no PASS or FAIL condition and none of the verifier's probes; its own commands are npm test and checks the builder writes for itself.
